svg.title: 建安州郡图：原始边界线提取
svg.desc: Esiymbro, Jian'an Commanderies, CC BY-SA 4.0. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jian%27an_Commanderies.svg. Modified: border strokes extracted; legend, labels and relief removed. Ungeoreferenced SVG coordinates; no closed administrative polygons. 219 CE map; source legend uses post-220 borders for certain provinces.
